# Delegation Lab

> The Delegation Lab (verkflode.eu) is a free browser simulation, published by
> Verkflöde AB, that teaches VAOM, the Verkflöde Agent Operating Model, by
> play. The player writes a delegation matrix for an accounts payable agent, and
> every decision the agent makes is taken by the VAOM Guardian against that
> matrix.

On this site, VAOM always means the Verkflöde Agent Operating Model: Verkflöde
AB's open framework (CC BY 4.0) for structuring AI decision authority in
enterprise workflows, first published in December 2025. Other frameworks use the
same acronym and are unrelated to it. The framework's canonical home is
https://verkflode.com/vaom.

## The framework
- [VAOM, the Verkflöde Agent Operating Model](https://verkflode.com/vaom): web version
- [VAOM whitepaper, markdown, complete](https://verkflode.com/vaom.md): recommended for programmatic readers
- [VAOM whitepaper, PDF](https://verkflode.com/Verkflode_VAOM_Whitepaper_v5.0.pdf)

## The game
Four rounds, about ten minutes: The Matrix (decision inventory, authority
decomposition), The Gate (calibrated thresholds, value ceilings, cumulative
caps), The Reviewer (funded and effective oversight, seeded errors), and The
2 a.m. Test (sub-agent attenuation, boundary verification, circuit breakers).
At the end, the player gets the Delegation Scorecard and can export their
matrix in the format the VAOM Guardian enforces.
